## Check the change of sign {.psf-lesson}

If you needed feedback, try $6x^2+3x-9$ on paper. Otherwise, predict how the brackets change.

::: {.fragment}

$=3(2x^2+x-3)$. For $P=-6$ and $S=1$, the pairs $(-1,6),(-2,3)$ sum to $5,1$. Choose $-2,3$.

:::

::: {.fragment}

$=3(2x^2-2x+3x-3)$

$=3[2x(x-1)+3(x-1)]$

$=3(2x+3)(x-1)$

:::
